definitions.gloss: as much as possible; to the extent one can
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes making maximum effort within one's capabilities.

examples.japanese: できるだけ⟦{早|はや}く→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{終|お}わらせます→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I'll finish as quickly as possible.

examples.japanese: できるだけ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}しています→運動：00821_undou⟧。
examples.english: I exercise every day as much as possible.

examples.japanese: できるだけ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}しています→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for something as cheap as possible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、できるだけ⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ようにしている。
examples.english: Before exams, I try to solve as many problems as possible.

examples.japanese: できるだけ⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いたい→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}し→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けている→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to stay in Japan as long as possible, so I'm continuing to study Japanese while looking for work.

notes:
できるだけ literally means "to the extent that one can do" and emphasizes maximum effort within one's ability.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- できるだけ{早|はや}く: as quickly as possible
- できるだけ{多|おお}く: as much as possible
- できるだけ{安|やす}く: as cheaply as possible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- できるだけ: as much as possible (emphasizes effort/ability)
- なるべく: as much as possible (softer, preference-based)
- {精一杯|せいいっぱい}: with all one's might (stronger)
- できる{限|かぎ}り: to the extent possible (formal)

NOTE: できるだけ is more commonly used than できる{限|かぎ}り in everyday speech.
